params.name: Show production
params.tooltip: Show each industry's production on its map label: the pill with the industry icon.

params.name: Show line pickup rate
params.tooltip: Show the summed rate of your lines that pick up each industry's output: the pill with the Line Manager icon.

params.name: Show warehouse rates
params.tooltip: Show each warehouse's incoming and outgoing cargo per year on its map label: one pill pair per cargo (box with down arrow = incoming, box with up arrow = outgoing).
